Seven major UK banks have completed live customer transactions using tokenised sterling deposits on the UK Finance GBTD platform developed by Quant.

The transactions included retail use cases such as remortgage completions and a consumer marketplace purchase. The next phase is expected to explore digital-asset settlement using tokenised commercial bank money.
